verdict.rationale: Customer.io's official MCP server lets you "work with segments", and its AI tooling can "build segments". Its CLI gives scripts "full access" to the Journeys UI API through `cio api`, and the App API is documented for fetching data, so programmatic segment work is a first-party capability. However, no evidence names segment create/update endpoints or explicitly documents reading back segment membership. missing for 10: explicit documented segment/list create-update API endpoints, documented endpoint for listing exact segment members, independent or hands-on corroboration.
